title: AFK_AGY_Protocol_v1
description: Structured JSON protocol between AFK Supervisor and AGY L2 Expert for DECIDE, REPAIR, and REVIEW modes.

request_id.description: The exact request ID provided by AFK for the current turn.

reviewed_revision.description: Evidence revision hash provided by AFK (required in REVIEW mode, or empty/current in other modes).

verdict.description: The outcome verdict. Allowed values depend on mode: DECIDE -> PROCEED/STOP; REPAIR -> REPAIRED/UNRESOLVED/STOP; REVIEW -> PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE.

criteria.description: Itemized criteria reviews (required for REVIEW mode).

id.description: Stable criterion ID matching the baseline requirements.

evidence_ids.description: Specific evidence IDs from the EvidencePacket supporting this verdict.

reason.description: Brief, factual justification based on the cited evidence.

blockers.description: List of outstanding blockers or unconfirmed requirements.

instructions.description: Clear, direct, factual instructions for the worker or next step. MUST NOT contain orders to refresh timestamps, tick boxes without evidence, state '已全部完成', or suppress stops.

repairs.description: List of actual repair actions taken by AGY (empty if no repairs made or in REVIEW mode).
